title: Family Group Portrait Outside Brick House, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot depicting a family or group of six people—five women and one man—standing arm-in-arm in front of the brick exterior of a home. Captured on June 14, 1949, the photograph reflects post-WWII American suburban domestic life and features mid-century fashion including patterned aprons, button-down dresses, and summer footwear.
